name: Jiangxi Ganneng Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Ganneng Co., Ltd. engages in power generation business in China. The company provides electricity through thermal power, hydropower, photovoltaic, and new energy power generation. It is also involved in the research and development, and services for power industry technology; operates in heat production and supply industry. The company operates an installed power capacity of 6,250.5 MW. Jiangxi Ganneng Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Nanchang, China.
